article.headline: South Carolina State beats Morris 94-55 behind Christian Barnes’ 12 points
article.description: — Christian Barnes scored 12 points as South Carolina State defeated Morris 94-55 in its opener Monday.
article.linkText: South Carolina State beats Morris 94-55 behind Christian Barnes’ 12 points

categories.description: Morris Hornets @ South Carolina State Bulldogs

event.description: Morris Hornets @ South Carolina State Bulldogs

keywords: Morris Hornets @ South Carolina State Bulldogs
article.story: ORANGEBURG, S.C. -- — Christian Barnes scored 12 points as South Carolina State defeated Morris 94-55 in its opener Monday. Barnes shot 4 for 7, including 4 for 6 from beyond the arc, for the Bulldogs. Jayden Pretty scored 10 points and added seven rebounds. Teon Tindal had nine points, shooting 4 for 6 from the field and 1 for 3 from the line. Demetrius Brown led the Hornets with 12 points. Jayden Hosien added nine points for Morris. Leith Kenon II finished with eight points. Up next South Carolina State’s next game is Friday at South Carolina Upstate. Morris visits Winthrop on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
